title: Testio Configuration
description: Schema for Testio test-suite configuration files. Kept in sync with testio.core.config_parser.parsers.validate_config_data.

command.description: Interpreter used to run the program; the program path is appended (e.g. 'python3', 'node').

run_command.description: Like 'command' but takes precedence over it. With compile_command, leave empty to run the compiled binary directly.

compile_command.description: Compilation command template. {source} is the source file name and {output} the path of the compiled artifact.

path.description: Program file, or a directory whose files are each tested. Relative to the config file.

TextBlock.description: Either one string (split on newlines) or a list of lines.

input.description: Standard input fed to the program.

output.description: Expected standard output. Trailing newlines are ignored.

timeout.description: Wall-clock limit in seconds. Capped by TESTIO_MAX_TEST_TIMEOUT (default 300).

use_regex.description: Treat the expected output as a regular expression that must match the whole output.

interleaved.description: Program alternates prompts and reads; input lines are supplied in order.

unordered.description: Compare output lines as a multiset, ignoring order and blank lines.
